element_title: Tree canopy and deep soil areas
title: Permeable paving or decking within a deep soil area: at most 20% of its area
text: The extent of permeable paving or decking within a deep soil area does not exceed 20 per cent of its area and does not inhibit the planting and growth of trees.
notes: landscape.deep_soil_permeable_paving_pct (proposed): share of the deep soil area under permeable paving or decking; where there are several deep soil areas, the highest share. 'Does not inhibit planting and growth' is not tested (judgment). Figure 3.3e.
